compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: push to story branch with delta > 400 LOC or 15 files triggers region-split path; CI log shows file-cluster partition and parallel reviewer dispatches
- DD3: opus arch synthesis pass produces at least one boundary-only finding on a fixture where a logic error spans two region clusters

## TDD Requirement
Write a new test file `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_region_split.py` asserting:

1. **Size gate**: `_should_region_split(diff_text)` returns True when diff has > 400 changed lines (lines starting with `+` or `-` excluding `+++`/`---` headers) OR > 15 changed files (hunks touching > 15 distinct filenames)
2. **Size gate negative**: returns False for a diff < 400 LOC and < 15 files
3. **Clustering**: `_cluster_files(filenames)` groups files by common directory prefix into clusters; each cluster has a combined diff text; max 5 clusters (files that don't fit a natural cluster land in an "overflow" cluster)
4. **Parallel dispatch**: `run_region_split(diff_text, tier_agents, provider_chain, config_path)` calls `async_dispatch_specialists` once per cluster (in parallel), returning per-cluster findings lists
5. **Arch synthesis receives all findings**: `run_region_split` calls `dispatch_arch_synthesis` with the merged per-cluster findings after parallel dispatch completes
6. **Boundary-only finding fixture**: Given a seeded arch synthesis mock returning a finding with `"boundary_cross_region": true`, `run_region_split` includes it in the returned findings

Tests MUST fail (RED) before T4 implements `region_split.py`.

## Test Approach
Given: a synthetic diff string with 20 changed files across 3 directories (> 15 file threshold)
When: `_should_region_split(diff_text)` is called
Then: returns True

Given: `_cluster_files(["src/a/x.py", "src/a/y.py", "src/b/z.py"])` is called
When: clustering by directory prefix
Then: returns 2 clusters: one for "src/a" (x.py, y.py), one for "src/b" (z.py)

Given: `run_region_split(large_diff, ...)` is called with mocked `async_dispatch_specialists` and `dispatch_arch_synthesis`
When: the function executes
Then: `async_dispatch_specialists` is called once per cluster; `dispatch_arch_synthesis` is called exactly once with merged findings; result includes boundary-only finding

RED marker: tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_region_split.py [test_size_gate_loc_threshold]

## Implementation Notes
- Test file must mock `dso_ci_review.dispatch.async_dispatch_specialists` and `dso_ci_review.dispatch.dispatch_arch_synthesis` — no real LLM calls
- Use `unittest.mock.patch` / `AsyncMock` for async_dispatch_specialists (it's an async function)
- Fixture diff for LOC test: generate programmatically — 401 `+` lines with a header `--- a/file.py\n+++ b/file.py\n@@ -1 +1,401 @@\n`
- Fixture for 15-file test: generate diff headers for 16 distinct files with 1 line each

## .test-index entry required
`test_region_split.py` does not fuzzy-match `region_split.py` (normalized: "regionsplitpy" vs "testregionsplitpy" — substring match PASSES, so .test-index entry is still required for the RED marker).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_region_split.py` exists
  Verify: test -f $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_region_split.py
- [ ] Tests FAIL before T4 (RED confirmed — module does not exist)
  Verify: PYTHONPATH=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_region_split.py 2>&1 | grep -qE "ImportError|ModuleNotFoundError|FAILED"
- [ ] `.test-index` updated with RED marker `[test_size_gate_loc_threshold]` for `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/region_split.py`
  Verify: grep '\[test_size_gate_loc_threshold\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
